pass_a_gloss: Comparison of the parables in which God man is-called. In the of-the-workers a householder goes-out to-hire; but in the of-the-supper and of-the-wedding of-the-son a king has-been-named — for greater than a householder as army sending. In Luke «a man planted a vineyard»; and in Mark likewise. In many-ways in the Scriptures God as man is-taken; much it-differs if simply man or householder or king is-named. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Compare the parables where God is called a man. In the laborers he is a [[householder hiring at dawn >> Bible:Matthew 20:1]]; in the supper and the son’s wedding he is named a [[king >> Bible:Matthew 22:2]] — greater than a householder, as one who sends an army. Luke and Mark say a man planted a vineyard. In the Scriptures God is taken as ‘man’ in many ways; it matters greatly whether he is named simply man, householder, or king. Glory to Christ. Amen.
